description: This file contains test cases for the litellm project, focusing on key management, access, cost tracking, and API interactions. It includes async test functions using pytest for testing various aspects such as key generation, updating, deletion, model listing, and spend calculations.

methods.name: generate_team( session, models: Optional[list] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None )

methods.name: generate_user( session, user_role="app_owner", )
methods.description: Creates a new user with a specified role for the team via API.
